title: Audio Memo Dispatched Event
description: The transcript was published as a bloodbank.cmd.agent.invocation.start command to the target agent. The command carries correlationid = memo_id. Part of the voice memo journey: every stage fact and the agent invocation share correlationid = data.memo_id and ordering_key 'memo:<memo_id>'. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

memo_id.description: Journey id: uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, 's3://holocene-auto/' + s3_key). Also the correlationid of this event and of the agent invocation command, so one correlationid query returns the whole journey.

s3_key.description: Object key of the voice memo in the holocene-auto bucket: inbox/<agent>/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<file>.

target_agent_id.description: Agent the memo is addressed to. Parsed from the S3 key path only, never inferred from audio.

command_id.description: command_id of the published command envelope; join key to the gateway journal and invocation.* events.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key of the command envelope.

command_subject.description: NATS subject the command was published to.

lane.description: Gateway lane the command was published to: interactive (invocation.invoke, reserved slots) or batch (invocation.start). Derivable from command_subject on older facts.

lane_reason.description: Why the lane differs from the configured one, or why a probe failed. interactive_consumer_not_pulling: the watcher fell back to batch because batch was pulling and interactive was not. gateway_not_pulling_queued_on_interactive: neither lane had a puller (gateway down or restarting), so the command was queued on the interactive lane, which drains first on reconnect. gateway_draining_queued_on_interactive: hermes-gateway was draining for a restart (its gateway_state.json said so), so nothing pulled on purpose; the command was queued on the interactive lane, which the new process fetches first. Null on the normal path.

thread_id.description: thread_id sent in the command; the agent session's chat_id.
